title: Email 1 arrives in a real inbox and looks right
instructions: Take the quiz at https://products.revalorllc.com/ai-quiz?src=test with your own email. Email 1 should arrive within a few minutes (check spam): both guide links open, the result line matches your level, and the footer shows the Middletown, DE address and an Unsubscribe link. Afterwards delete your row from vw_ai_quiz_leads or set call_booked_at so the follow-ups stop.

title: A call request alerts info@revalorllc.com
instructions: Automated tests use Resend test addresses, which never trigger the alert. Take the quiz with your own email, pick a business in Q2 and tick the free-call box. info@revalorllc.com should get 'AI quiz: free call request' with your answers, and replying should go to the address you used.

title: The QR codes in both guides open the consulting page
instructions: Open https://products.revalorllc.com/guides/ai-basics.pdf and ai-next-level.pdf, go to the last page and scan each QR code with a phone. Each should open products.revalorllc.com/consulting.

title: Unsubscribe from a real email works
instructions: In an AI quiz email you received, click Unsubscribe, then the Unsubscribe button. You should see "You're unsubscribed." and your row's unsubscribed_at should be set.
